_about: Impact lines for the README contributions table. PRs found by search but missing here still get a row, using the PR title. Closed-unmerged PRs never show.

notes.career-ops-hq/career-ops: On the project's Contributor team since November 2026.
notes.vercel-labs/agent-browser: My fix was folded into a maintainer PR, with co-author credit.

prs.career-ops-hq/career-ops#7098: The updater no longer says "up to date" when the commit lookup fails, such as on an API rate limit. It reports drift, and a test stubs the failed lookup.
prs.career-ops-hq/career-ops#3711: The doctor command detects project-scoped Playwright MCP installs, resolving config in precedence order.
prs.career-ops-hq/career-ops#3591: Hardened context-budget prompt assembly and tracker-path handling.
prs.we-promise/sure#5038: Rotating the Brandfetch client ID in settings repairs every stored merchant and security logo, with no data backfill.
prs.eugenioenko/ttt#1601: New untitled files follow the editor's insertSpaces and tabSize settings, checked against the built binary.
prs.vercel-labs/agent-browser#2737: frame "#selector" resolves cross-origin iframes, covered by an end-to-end test in real Chrome.
prs.conductor-oss/conductor#1831: The MySQL queue keeps its unack sweep scheduled after a failed run, so a dropped DB connection no longer strands workflows until restart.
